description: Erection of side and double rear dormer extensions with three front roof windows and single storey rear extension following demolision of existing extension to the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ([Design and Access Statement], [PL110], [PL111], [PL112], [PL100], [PL101], [PL102], [PL103], [PL500], [PL920], [PL921], [PL200], [PL201], Received: 29/01/2020
[PL202A], [PL203A], [PL210A], [PL211A], [PL212A], [PL213A], Received: 05/03/2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the side elevation shall be obscured glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
